project_type: Next.js 16 App Router web app (TypeScript, React 19, Tailwind v4) - an AI-assisted study platform
build_system: npm scripts on Next.js 16. Node 22 via nvm; in this sandbox run `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22` before any npm command. AGENTS.md warns this is a modified Next.js - the agent-rules block in AGENTS.md is auto-regenerated by `next dev`; commit it if it appears in the diff.
test_framework: Vitest (jsdom environment for some tests). Tests colocated in `__tests__/` dirs. Existing test count ~93 and must stay green keyless.
build_command: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npm run build
verification_instructions: Run all four KEYLESS (no LLM/Supabase env set): `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build`. All must pass with the mock provider as the zero-config fallback. Add new keyless unit tests for provider selection and any new parsing/prompt helpers.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. The AGENTS.md nextjs-agent-rules block is regenerated by `next dev`; if it changes it should be committed to keep the tree clean.
environment_constraints: network_mode OPEN_INTERNET. Do NOT hardcode any API key. Provider constructors MUST NOT throw at construction for a missing key and MUST NOT touch the network at import. The app must remain fully KEYLESS-green: lint/typecheck/test/build with no env set, using MockProvider as fallback. Tests must not depend on a live network.
contribution_requirements: Preserve the existing `LLMProvider` interface (`src/lib/llm/types.ts`) and all downstream zod schema contracts (`src/lib/analyze/types.ts`). No consumer may break. Mock stays the deterministic keyless fallback. Commit on branch `feat/grok-llm-provider` (already created off origin/main); do NOT push.
key_patterns: LLMProvider abstraction in src/lib/llm: types.ts (interface + CompleteOptions{system,temperature,maxTokens}), index.ts (getLLMProvider factory), openai.ts (OpenAIProvider via official `openai` SDK v7, uses chat.completions.create with response_format json_object for completeJSON, model from OPENAI_MODEL default gpt-4o-mini), mock.ts (deterministic MockProvider). xAI is OpenAI-compatible: `new OpenAI({ apiKey, baseURL: 'https://api.x.ai/v1' })`. Consumers: analyzeBook.ts (map/reduce; calls completeJSON per chunk with chunkAnalysisSchema {summary, keywords}, system prompt 'Extract a concise summary and the key concepts from this study material.'); generateQuestions.ts (calls completeJSON per concept with questionDraftSchema {summary, keywords}, system 'Explain this concept concisely for an exam answer.', takes draft.summary as the answer body); study/prompt.ts (pure learning-style copy, no LLM call). Note: probability/questionType/ranking are computed LOCALLY by heuristics, not by the LLM; the LLM only supplies summary/keywords text. Prompt improvements must keep the {summary, keywords} JSON contract but make the instructions produce grounded, on-topic content.
directory_structure: src/lib/llm = pluggable LLM providers + factory. src/lib/analyze = curriculum-aware analysis + ranked question generation (consumes LLMProvider). src/lib/study = SM-2 scheduler, session engine, concept map, learning-style prompt copy (pure). src/lib/ingest = parsing + chunking. src/lib/store = Supabase-or-in-memory persistence. src/app/api = route handlers. Tests live in colocated __tests__/ folders.
